title: Life Expectancy Gender Gap Analysis
text:
Methodology
The analysis uses: - Bayesian hierarchical panel models (implemented in both PyMC and brms) - Panel data from 37 OECD countries over 24 years (2000-2023) - Gender gap indicators for 12 mortality causes (cardiovascular disease, alcohol, suicide, etc.)
